description: Multi-GPU DCGM monitoring using the exact supplied metric names. Flat-tariff GPU energy cost in EUR. Fleet overview with per-GPU drilldown.

panels.description: Distinct UUIDs with a valid framebuffer capacity sample at the selected end time. Offline GPUs are not inferred from this count.
panels.title: GPUs reporting

panels.description: Unweighted mean of GPU activity ratios across reporting GPUs. Mixed GPU models do not have equal throughput.
panels.title: GPU activity · mean

panels.description: Sum of used framebuffer bytes divided by sum of capacity bytes. Only UUIDs with both measurements are included. This is allocation, not memory-interface activity.

targets.expr: (sum(max by (UUID) ((DCGM_FI_DEV_FB_USED_BYTES{job=~"${job:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}",hostname=~"${host:regex}",modelName=~"${model:regex}",UUID=~"${gpu:regex}"} >= 0 < 1e18)) and on (UUID) (max by (UUID) ((DCGM_FI_DEV_FB_CAPACITY_BYTES{job=~"${job:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}",hostname=~"${host:regex}",modelName=~"${model:regex}",UUID=~"${gpu:regex}"} >= 0 < 1e18)) > 0)) / sum((max by (UUID) ((DCGM_FI_DEV_FB_CAPACITY_BYTES{job=~"${job:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}",hostname=~"${host:regex}",modelName=~"${model:regex}",UUID=~"${gpu:regex}"} >= 0 < 1e18)) > 0) and on (UUID) max by (UUID) ((DCGM_FI_DEV_FB_USED_BYTES{job=~"${job:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}",hostname=~"${host:regex}",modelName=~"${model:regex}",UUID=~"${gpu:regex}"} >= 0 < 1e18))))

panels.title: VRAM allocated · fleet

panels.description: Sum of valid GPU board-power readings. Excludes CPU, cooling, PSU losses and the rest of the host.
panels.title: Board power · total

panels.description: Maximum current GPU temperature. 75/85°C colors are adjustable advisory thresholds, not device-specific throttling limits.
panels.title: Hottest GPU

panels.description: Count of reporting GPUs with temperature >=80°C. Advisory only; no throttle-reason or hardware-specific thermal-limit metrics were supplied.
panels.title: GPUs at or above 80°C

panels.description: GPU joule-counter increase over the dashboard time range, divided by 3,600,000. Counter resets are handled by increase(). Missing energy counters make this a partial total.
panels.title: Recorded energy · range

panels.description: Recorded GPU kWh × manually entered EUR/kWh. One flat price applies to the full selected interval. Missing energy data makes this a partial total.
panels.title: Estimated cost · range

panels.description: Current summed GPU board power /1000 × EUR/kWh. This is an instantaneous cost rate, not an accumulated cost or an unconditional forecast.
panels.title: Current cost rate

panels.description: Counter increase over the dashboard time range, calculated per raw series before summing. Prometheus extrapolation can produce fractional increases; displayed values are rounded.
panels.title: PCIe retries · range

panels.description: One row per UUID. Current measurements use the end of the selected time range; range columns cover the full selected interval. Missing data stays blank. Counter totals require one logical scrape series per GPU. Exporter hostname may be a container ID. UUID identifies a physical GPU; GPU index is local to its host.
panels.title: GPU inventory · click UUID to drill down

panels.description: GPU activity is a 0–1 ratio. High activity does not establish tensor saturation or application throughput.
panels.title: GPU activity · per GPU

panels.description: Used framebuffer bytes / total capacity. GPU model weights do not affect this per-GPU ratio.
panels.title: VRAM allocated · per GPU

panels.description: Fraction of cycles the tensor pipe is active. Hardware and profiler support vary; absent samples are not zero usage.
panels.title: Tensor-pipe activity · per GPU

panels.description: Fraction of cycles the device memory interface sends or receives data. This is activity, not allocated VRAM or measured bytes/s.
panels.title: DRAM-interface activity · per GPU

panels.description: rate(joules_total) is joules/second = watts. Differences can reflect different sampling and smoothing windows or missing counters; neither trace is wall-socket power.
panels.title: Fleet power · board readings vs energy counter

panels.description: Compare thermal trends across GPUs. Device-specific throttle limits are not present in the supplied metrics.
panels.title: Temperature · per GPU

panels.description: Current GPU board-power readings /1000 × the selected flat price. Area is not used to calculate the range-cost stat; the joule counter is used for that.
panels.title: Fleet electricity cost rate

panels.description: These supplied PCIe gauges already contain bytes per second, including protocol overhead. No rate() is applied.
panels.title: Fleet PCIe traffic

panels.description: rate(PCIe replay counter) calculated before aggregation. A nonzero retry rate warrants correlation with traffic, errors and hardware; this metric alone does not diagnose a fault.
panels.title: PCIe retry rate · per GPU

panels.description: Top 20 GPUs in the current selection over the selected dashboard time range. Click a value to open its GPU drilldown. Historical GPUs can appear here even if they no longer report.
panels.title: Recorded energy · top 20 GPUs · range

panels.description: Top 20 GPUs in the current selection over the selected dashboard time range. Click a value to open its GPU drilldown. Historical GPUs can appear here even if they no longer report.
panels.title: Estimated cost · top 20 GPUs · range

list.name: datasource

list.description: Use one logical scrape path per physical GPU. Duplicate counter series will overcount energy and retries.
list.label: Exporter job
list.name: job

list.description: Prometheus target address. Useful when the exporter hostname is a container ID.
list.label: Scrape instance
list.name: instance

list.description: Uses the supplied hostname label; this can be a container ID rather than the physical host.
list.label: Exporter hostname
list.name: host

list.description: Filter by GPU model. Mixed models have different performance and thermal limits.
list.label: GPU model

list.label: GPU UUID
list.name: gpu

list.description: Enter a non-negative number with a decimal point, e.g. 0.30. Flat EUR/kWh tariff applied to the entire displayed time range. GPU energy only.
list.label: Price (EUR/kWh)
